# دندانپزشکی دکتر مینا مازندرانی

Official public website for patient-facing dental education and service discovery in Persian.

Canonical public test origin: https://galaxy1364.github.io/SiteMinadental/
Target production domain (not yet verified): https://minadentalclinic.ir/

## Safety
Content is educational and does not replace examination, diagnosis, prescription, or an individual treatment plan.
Operational claims, prices, contact details, reviews and clinical credentials are published only when owner-verified.
